name: A-level Physics (AQA 7408): Astrophysics option

selected_options.practical_endorsement: not covered (teacher-assessed, separate from the grade)

material_vintage: AQA AS and A-level Physics (7407/7408) specification, Version 1.4 (July 2026), linked from aqa.org.uk/7408 and itemised on 2026-09-27: every content code at its deepest level (3.1.1-3.13.6.4), the mathematical requirements MS 0.1-4.7, the practical skills PS1.1-4.1, the apparatus and techniques ATa-l and the twelve required practicals. This course takes the Astrophysics option (3.9); the other four options and the hands-on apparatus list (practical endorsement only) are declared out of scope. Assessment: Paper 1 (2 h, 85 marks, 34%: sections 3.1-3.5 and 3.6.1), Paper 2 (2 h, 85 marks, 34%: 3.6.2, 3.7, 3.8, assuming 3.1-3.6.1), Paper 3 (2 h, 80 marks, 32%: practical skills and data analysis 45 marks, option 35 marks). Stage tests and the mock are original questions in AQA's style; every numerical answer was computed when the course was built.
level_source: RQF Level 3 (GCE A-level), per Ofqual's register listing for AQA 7408

learner_notices.text: The A-level grade comes only from the written papers. AQA also reports a separate practical endorsement, assessed by a teacher watching you work in a lab. This course teaches the required practicals' methods, analysis and evaluation for the written papers, but it cannot award or replace the endorsement.

This course follows the Astrophysics option in Paper 3 Section B. If you are entered for Medical, Applied (Engineering), Turning points or Electronics instead, you will need another source for that option.
